about: Copperleaf's festivals and market days (hub track HB-10e, the owner's answers 2026-10-27): four seasonal festivals by the real date (a week each, by the ranch clock: logic/ranch-clock.js), two milestones and a market day every few returns. At most one is on: a milestone first, then a date, then a market day. Each brings its decorations (Copperleaf's props whose when names the festival), the square's folk out longer (its day, in place of rules.json square.day), its folk's lines (banter.json square_fest) and a festival market at the middle stall, paid in cur (each ware n per festival). Hub only: a run sees none.

homecoming.name: Homecoming Parade
homecoming.about: Your first win! Copperleaf has put its flags out and its feet up.

tenth_departure.name: Tenth Departure
tenth_departure.about: Ten trains out, ten trains home. The station master has baked a cake shaped like a timetable.

sprout_fair.name: Sprout Fair
sprout_fair.about: The spring seed swap: seed packets, seedlings and far too much elderflower cordial.

longest_light.name: Longest Light
longest_light.about: Midsummer: the solar roofs drink all day, and nobody goes to bed while it's light.

spire_supper.name: Spire Supper
spire_supper.about: The harvest supper: hay bales for chairs, the whole town at one table, and somebody always brings soup.

lantern_walk.name: Lantern Walk
lantern_walk.about: Midwinter: lanterns from the square to the station and back, to light the trains home.

market_day.name: Market day
market_day.about: Market day: the stalls stay out till afternoon, and the middle one has something good under the counter.
